degree.text: Degree Awarded Bachelor's Degree of Medicine

description.text: School of pharmacy The department of pharmaceutics is one of the academic departments in theschool of pharmacy. The academic policy of the Department of pharmaceutics is to produce graduates with well-round scholastic activities, good morality and professional etiquette, and experiences in pharmaceutics.This department offers excellent infrastructure, which includes laboratories having advanced instrumental facilities, well furnished classrooms, seminar room etc. The department is now involved in a variety of academic programmes. The department provides a broad based education background emphasizing the theoretical and practical disciplines essential for the dosage form design, evaluation and manufacture, and development of raw material for pharmaceutical applications.Employment Orientation Graduates are supposed to undertake teaching and oral diseases treatments in medical schools, hospitals and clinics at all levels.Fees Application: 130USDTuition:RMB22000Accommodation: RMB5000Residence permit & photos: RMB840Medical examination:RMB406Book: RMB800Beddings:RMB500Accomodation deposit:RMB 400Incurance:RMB 600White Doctor Coat:RMB120Library card:RMB10Student Card: RMB10Degree Awarded Bachelor's Degree of Medicine

duration.text: The Pharmacy at Jinzhou Medical University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3055 USD/per year ￥ 22000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included.For the regarding authority must make sure that there are at least two pages on the passport for the Chinese Embassy to stick the Visa paper and Immigration to stick the resident permit paper.2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.3. Academic transcript of high school4. Graduation certificate of high school Gradution certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not,it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.5. Sponsorship Certificate6.Photocopy of 1st page to 8th page of your valid passport (Liaoning) For the regarding authority must make sure that there are at least two pages on the passport for the Chinese Embassy to stick the Visa paper and Immigration to stick the resident permit paper

requirements.text: 1. Applicant is under the age of 252. Be in good health 3. High-school graduate with good marks
